segments.name: AI services
segments.description: AI-powered customer engagement software and AI+BPO services for enterprises; users are contact center and sales professionals.
segments.evidence: CODM regularly reviews entity-wide operating results and reviews consolidated revenues and net income when making decisions about allocating resources and assessing performance of the segment, and hence, the Group has only one single principal reportable segment, i.e. AI services, which is considered as the primary revenue source of the Group.
